selection.method: Every RICH pair from the persisted official validation/ego index, sorted by recording then start.
selection.note: One source has 165 frames and no legal 192-frame window; 856 tail frames of the other sources are outside this grid. See source_coverage.

aggregation: Full indexed window-weighted and equal-recording macro, clean/noisy separately. Overlapping windows are retained; not an independent TEST or an assumed external-paper protocol.
